subject: planner,indexjoin: Fix the panic of indexjoin + streamagg (#60852)
summary: Reviewed commit f31534234a55b591b0186ed1fec6ba57b4caf607 vs first parent, scoped to planner change in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`. The change updates the stream-agg path for index-join inner tasks to correctly handle index lookup (double-read) by locating the underlying `PhysicalTableScan` (table scan or selection->table scan), and when enabling `KeepOrder` it synchronizes cop-task fields (`extraHandleCol`, `needExtraProj`, `originSchema`) to avoid the previously missing extra-handle/projection setup that could lead to a panic. The added fallback (`goto buildHashAgg`) avoids attempting stream-agg when the table-scan pattern is not supported. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, semantics, or runtime safety issues found in the touched planner logic.
